speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, how long have you been experiencing confusion, abdominal pain, and vomiting?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old female. The patient presents to the emergency department with confusion that started this morning. The patient's husband reports that she initially complained of abdominal pain, diarrhea, and fatigue after eating and has vomited 3 times. The patient has progressively become more confused throughout the day. The patient's past medical history includes morbid obesity, diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, a sleeve gastrectomy 1 month ago, and depression with multiple suicide attempts.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) precipitated by recent gastric sleeve surgery and suspected food poisoning.

I will confirm your history of Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes and ask if you notice a fruity odor on your breath or feel excessively thirsty. Please also confirm if you have checked your blood sugar levels today and what the reading was. REQUEST TEST: Basic Metabolic Panel, Serum Ketones, Arterial Blood Gas.
